serverUrl.title: Server address
serverUrl.description: Root address of the ApiMocktle server, e.g. http://localhost:4000

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Generate it in ApiMocktle under Settings › Tokens; it is kept in this machine's plugin settings

schemaDepth.title: Request/response body depth
schemaDepth.description: How many levels of DTO fields are resolved (1-4); deeper type chains stop changing past this, and 3 levels already cover the usual shapes

resolveDependencyJars.title: Resolve types from dependency jars
resolveDependencyJars.description: Read dependency jars from the local Maven repository to resolve DTOs and wrappers that are not in the sources (such as Result<T> or ResponseEntity<T>)

mavenRepository.title: Local Maven repository
mavenRepository.description: Empty means ~/.m2/repository. After moving it, also change the fs.read entry in plugin.toml to the same path and reinstall to grant it — file permissions are granted from the manifest at install time and cannot change at runtime (see README)
